title: Little Girl in White Fur Coat in Snow, 1930s Winter Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait captures a young girl bundled up against the cold in a fuzzy white coat, matching winter cap, and lace-up boots. She squints into the intense glare of the sun reflecting off the deep snow around her. In the background, tall leafless trees cast shadows across a residential street where an early boxy automobile is parked amidst high snowdrifts. The reverse side bears corner mounts discoloration from an album and a single stamped number.
